spellbook.finance/limitations: workspaceId validates caller ownership only. The saved eBay shipping-mode preference belongs to the caller's connected account and can affect future listing or repricing work across all of that caller's workspaces.
setByDelegatedAgent reports whether a delegated caller last saved the preference; it does not prove provider fulfillment-policy or checkout state.

description: Read the shipping-mode preference saved for the caller's connected eBay account and whether a delegated agent last set it. workspaceId proves owner access only; the preference is account-scoped.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

workspaceId.description: Workspace the caller owns; used for delegated authorization. Required.

name: spellbook_ebay_shipping_mode_get
